basis_rationale: Adopt 2024 constant EUR to match the historical market reference. Existing analyst EUR costs are assigned this convention; they are not revalued from any source-year cost estimate. This is a new bookkeeping assumption, not empirical calibration.
excluded_costs: Construction-period financing and timing; explicit major replacement costs; tax/debt structure; decommissioning; industrial investment needed for learning. The 5 EUR/MWh variable OPEX is an aggregate placeholder, not a verified fuel-cycle cost.
parameter_dependencies: CF depends on maintenance, reliability and derating. Net output depends on auxiliary power. Learning affects only the assumed magnet CAPEX share. Higher reliability may increase costs. Existing sensitivity axes are not joint feasible scenarios.
performance_comparison_reference: 8000 EUR_2024/kWe at CF 0.85; separate from the CAL002 mid-cost reference
planning_horizon: 2035-2050 context only; no plant COD or construction schedule currently modeled
boundary_scope: Legacy annual LCOE and Stage 4.5 DCF; lifecycle extension declares staged investment and replacement boundaries separately in lifecycle_cash_flow_cases.json.
